website.readme_excerpt: # FFXIV Login Commands Run chat commands automatically when a character logs in. Supports per-character profiles, global commands, delays, ordering, and execution logs. - [Installation](#installation) - [Releases](https://github.com/AEBus/FFXIV-Login-Commands/releases) ## Installation FFXIV Login Commands is a Dalamud plugin and requires FFXIVQuickLauncher to start the game. 1. Type `/xlsettings` in chat to open Dalamud Settings. 2. Open the "Experimental" tab and scroll to "Custom Plugin Repositories". 3. Paste the repo URL below and press the "+" button. 4. Press "Save and Close". 5. Open `/xlplugins`, search for FFXIV Login Commands, and click install. Repo URL ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AEBus/FFXIV-Login-Commands/master/repo.json ```
